title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether a Prison Doctor Who Is Not Formally Recruited by a Public Security Organ May Constitute the Subject of the Crime of Dereliction of Duty Causing the Escape of Detainees

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2000] No. 28
To the Higher People's Court of Jilin Province:
The Court's Request for Instructions on Whether Judicial Personnel Not Formally Employed but Entrusted to Perform Duties Constitute the Subject of a Crime (Ji Gao Fa [1999] No. 158) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
Any person who is not formally employed by a public security organ but is entrusted to perform supervisory duties, who, due to gross negligence, causes an inmate to escape, resulting in serious consequences, shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 400 of the Criminal Law.
A prison doctor who does not have supervisory duties shall not constitute the subject of the crime of dereliction of duty causing the escape of an inmate. However, a prison doctor who is assigned to assume supervisory duties and, due to gross negligence, causes an inmate to escape, resulting in serious consequences, shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 400 of the Criminal Law.
This reply.
